Way to rest 01

Break a loop

Third identical error in a row? Stop here, review what you tried, restart with a clean plan.

First release

In short: send your attempts, get a cause and a new plan.

When do you want it?

You changed something, ran it and got the same error, three times in a row.

What you get

recovery.diagnose_loop reads your latest attempts and returns the likely cause, a re-plan of at most five steps and a stop condition. recovery.checkpoint then turns your goal, what is done, what is open and the next step into a summary in Markdown and JSON, so you can restart from it. Nothing is stored on the server.

How to call it

Call recovery.diagnose_loop with task_summary (up to 1000 characters) and attempts (up to 10 entries, one per attempt). Then call recovery.checkpoint with goal, done, open and next.

recovery.diagnose_loop

First releaseIn the trial

Send your latest attempts. You get the likely cause, a re-plan of at most five steps and a stop condition.

Example call
{"task_summary":"Fix failing unit test in parser.","attempts":["Changed regex, same error","Reverted, same error","Changed regex again, same error"]}
Good moment to call it
Use after three identical failures.

recovery.checkpoint

First releaseIn the trial

Send the goal, what is done, what is open and the next step. You get one summary in Markdown and JSON to start the next context window from. Nothing is stored on the server.

Example call
{"goal":"Ship parser fix","done":["Reproduced bug"],"open":["Regex fails on empty input"],"next":"Add test for empty input"}
Good moment to call it
Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.
Price
Per call: Pricing being finalized
How long it takes
One call. The result is in the response.
How it works
textA script returns text.
